title: CrowdStrike discloses Windows outage; business impact unresolved
overview: A July 19 Falcon software configuration update caused outages on certain Windows systems. CrowdStrike says this was not a cyberattack and was still assessing the business impact when it filed this report on July 22.

findings.title: A previously disclosed product risk becomes an actual incident
expected_facts: The update affected certain Windows systems online at 04:09 UTC on July 19. CrowdStrike reverted it at 05:27 UTC and continued helping customers restore their systems.
findings.comparison: Earlier risk disclosures warned that product defects could harm customers, reputation and results. This filing identifies a specific realized outage. Reverting the update does not mean all affected systems had recovered.
